routes.name: Visa and Entry Permit exemption
routes.summary: Nationals of 88 listed countries don't need a visa or Entry Permit. Stay is 30 days by default, 90 days for EU/Schengen and a few others, and 6 months for British citizens.

other: Passport valid at least 90 days beyond the stay.
Valid onward or return ticket, unless you prove residence in Mainland China or Hong Kong.
Proof of funds: MOP 5,000 for up to 7 days, MOP 10,000 for 8 to 14 days, MOP 15,000 for 15 to 21 days, MOP 20,000 for over 21 days.
US passports are listed, except US diplomatic passports.
3 months: Cyprus, Israel, Lebanon, New Zealand. 14 days: Brunei, Kazakhstan. Also 90 days for Brazil, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, Monaco.

stay.note: Default 30 days. 90 days for EU/Schengen and some others. 6 months for UK citizens.

routes.processing: No application. Overstay fine is MOP 500 to 800 per day, capped at MOP 15,000.

routes.name: Prior Authorization to Enter and Stay
routes.summary: Non-residents who aren't visa exempt, or who want to work, study or join family, need this from the Public Security Police Force. It's not a residence permit.

other: Documents vary by purpose, for example an admission letter for students or employment approval for workers.
Passport valid at least 90 days beyond the stay.
Proof of financial means, such as a bank statement.

documents: Application form (Format 1), plus Format 8 if family is included
Bank statement or proof of funds
routes.processing: About 15 working days after complete documents, per the page. Must be used within 120 days of the grant date.

sources.label: Macao SAR Government: Authorization to Enter and Stay
